name: uk-airport-drop-off-charges
title: UK Airport Drop-Off Charges Dataset
description: Verified, dated drop-off and pick-up charges at 29 UK airports. Updated 28 Oct 2026.

fields.name: iata
fields.description: Three-letter IATA airport code, for example LHR.

fields.name: fee_gbp
fields.description: The charge in pounds for the drop-off zone nearest the terminal. 0 means it is free.

fields.name: free_minutes
fields.description: The time allowance in minutes: how long the charge covers, or how long is free at an airport that doesn't charge. 0 means a charge per entry with no time allowance. The name is historical.

fields.name: window_note
fields.description: The charge and its time limit in plain English.

fields.name: free_alternative
fields.description: The airport's own free or cheaper place to drop off. In the CSV this is its name, or "None". In the JSON it is an object: exists, name, detail, transfer (how you get to the terminal from it) and, for some airports, allow (how much extra time to leave).

fields.name: alt_detail
fields.description: CSV only: a description of the free alternative. In the JSON this is free_alternative.detail.

fields.name: verified
fields.description: The date this airport's figures were last checked, as YYYY-MM-DD.

fields.name: verification
fields.description: official: confirmed on the airport's own website. secondary: confirmed against published comparisons instead.

fields.name: source
fields.description: The website the figures were checked against.
